evidence.note: S639 completed one CLO 2026.1.310 DXF-AAMA native Button/Buttonhole export and clean reimport from a disposable Woven project. CLO returned 12 pieces without an import error, but the button became a radius-1.0 cm 24-vertex polygon instead of the source radius-0.15 cm MARK_BUTTON circle; the buttonhole became a slot instead of its source MARK_BUTTONHOLE point. Both centers shifted about 0.07616 cm, above the unchanged 0.001 cm limit. Detailed reimport readability remains unverified because the live 2D view is zoom-cropped. No V03 gate or hold clears.
